correctness.rationale: The symbolic two-order Nijenhuis defect vanishes identically for a general 2-by-2 matrix. The induced bracket simplifies to det(x,y)(c z1+d z2)(d e1-c e2); a direct basis normalization proves every nonzero deformation is isomorphic to the original system. Exact finite-field matrix counts and exhaustive checks confirm the formulas.

value.rationale: The minimal nonabelian two-dimensional Lie triple system is a natural first test object. The cubic Nijenhuis condition vanishes on the entire four-dimensional endomorphism algebra, while every induced deformation falls into only two isomorphism types; this is a strong structural benchmark, not a narrow numerical slice.
